Mosquito Control

The #1 complaint at every lake house

Our Lake Martin mosquito program is engineered for waterfront. We treat your yard, shoreline, and surrounding vegetation on a recurring schedule throughout mosquito season (April–October). 50% off your first treatment.

Termite Control

Moisture + wood = termite paradise

Lake Martin's humidity and water proximity create ideal termite conditions. We inspect and treat decks, docks, crawlspaces, and structural wood with solutions specific to high-moisture environments.
